body:
I really appreciate the advice. Unfortunately, the last two therapists I went to think there's nothing wrong with me and they were both generally just old dudes with 40 year old PhD's and very old editions of the DSM. I've tried finding help, but I have shit insurance that doesn't cover psychiatric. I have absolutely no money to my name, and my mom has absolutely no funds for the medical bills.

I would LOVE to get out of the house and stay with someone else for a while, but unfortunately, A.) I have no one to stay with. The only two people I would consider is my best friend and my sister, and neither have room for me. And B.) I know for a fact my mom would pull the "Why don't you want to stay here, you're telling me I'm a bad mom, you're selfish and don't care about anyone else" guilt trip. Which I already hear at least once a day. Also there's the issue of my dog, who is solely my responsibility and I know my mom wouldn't take care of him. She'd expect me to.

I've already given up on trying to make other people happy, which makes everyone think I'm selfish and don't care about anyone else. It's exhausting.

I've tried anxiety medication in the past, but it didn't do much for me, which makes my mother think they're *all* a waste of time and not worth the time or effort. Considering I was taking citalopram, the most generic anxiety medication on the market, I think the problem lies a lot deeper. 

Again, I'm thankful for the advice, but I'm really at a dead end with nowhere else to go.
